slides.title: I'm somewhere, you're somewhere
slides.message: You might already know this song because its already in life is strange track, but I heard it while watching Butterfly Theory and thought of you. I figured you might like it too and if u already heard it, listening to it again wont hurt :p !

slides.title: Don’t hold too tight that girl was born to fly
slides.message: this song i instantly thought of u when i heard it.  you are that girl "Star of the show and everybody knows it' , betty but make it for  bon.  this was the whole reason i made the playlist mainly for me,  i wanted something to express how i see you / recognize you as  and i started adding one by one until it became something i can share with you.

slides.title: oh forgive me lord I'm a good girl
slides.message: its mischievous and playful sounding its exactly what i would describe you as often but the lyrics got more meaning to them ( obviously like you )  " you put me me in this house, i had to crawl right out.

slides.title: You wide-eyed girls You get it right
slides.message:
was listening to random music on Spotify after a playlist ended and this song started playing, it was not hitting until he said " You wide-eyed girls
You get it right " and you came to my mind with your wide beautiful  big brown eyes :)  . I'm sure i heard this song before i just never noticed that you are doe eyed,  
hopefully no one else but me realize that you have doe eyes or they might take them away!!
